subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Doctor-required, one-way device-identity migration that deliberately does not support JSON-only downgrade after the legacy file is retired?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and recovery-policy contract across Node and Apple processes, not a mechanical implementation choice that review automation can safely make.

options.title: Accept after recovery proof
options.body: Approve the one-way cutover only after the reset regression is fixed and real upgrade/recovery evidence confirms the stated operator contract.

options.title: Require a reversible upgrade path
options.body: Keep a supported downgrade or export path, accepting additional migration and state-ownership complexity.

recommendation.title: Accept after recovery proof
recommendation.body: Approve the one-way cutover only after the reset regression is fixed and real upgrade/recovery evidence confirms the stated operator contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the active owner of the migration design and related SQLite state changes.
